statement: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε → (∑' i : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (ε * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (i + 1))) = ENNReal.ofReal ε
proof:
intro ε hε
have hhalf : ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
  norm_num
simp_rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul hε, ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, ENNReal.tsum_geometric_add_one, hhalf,
  ENNReal.one_sub_inv_two, inv_inv]
simp
